testCases.testName: Function: Get help from BingChat

testScenarios.objective: Verify Bing Chat capabilities inside Edge browser including code creation, summarization, UI alteration, and tab organization.
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Steps:
1. Left click Edge icon in task bar.
2. Left click Copilot icon. Choose a conversation style (Note: Some of the answers might be unreliable if you choose the "More Creative" style).
3. Create reference code:
- Go to the chat tab at Bing Chat.
- Choose the conversation style "More Precise".
- Type the prompt: "Create a personal website using HTML/Javascript/CSS with my biography, resume, and contact details."
- Check the code in a CSS previewer to make sure the code works (Reference: HTML_CSS_Reference.png).
4. Summary website page:
- Find a WIKI page on Edge.
- Ask Bing Chat to provide a summary by typing the prompt: "Generate page summary".
5. Switch to vertical tab:
- Ask Bing Chat to help change your tabs format by typing the prompt: "Switched tabs to vertical tabs".
6. Organize my tab:
- Open multiple tabs on Edge (at least over 6 tabs containing over 3 distinct categories).
- Ask Copilot to help organize the tabs by typing the prompt: "organize my tabs".
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
Description and Expected Result:
- For code creation: Make sure the generated layout code compiles and works cleanly in a previewer environment.
- For page summary: Check that the response accurately matches the real content of the loaded WIKI page.
- For vertical tabs: Make sure the browser application UI layout transforms to vertical tabs correctly.
- For tab organization: Make sure the multiple open tabs are cleanly organized and structured into accurate groups by their categories.

testCases.testName: Copilot in Microsoft 365  - Copilot in Word

testScenarios.prerequisite: Ask or type in the following questions
testScenarios.detailedSteps:
Steps:
1. Start a draft with Copilot in Word:
- Start a new blank document.
- In the Draft with Copilot box, type or paste your prompt. For example, "Write me a quick and easy recipe for chocolate chip cookies." or create a draft by reference selected document.
- Select Generate.

2. Transform your content with Copilot in Word [Rewrite Text]:
- Select the text you want Copilot to rewrite.
- In the left margin next to your text, select the Copilot icon.
- From the left margin Copilot menu, select Rewrite with Copilot.
- Select Replace to use the revised text, or try other options Copilot provides.

3. Transform text to a table:
- Select the text you want Copilot to turn into a table.
- In the left margin next to your text, select the Copilot icon.
- From the left margin Copilot menu, select Visualize as a table.
- Select Keep it to insert the table.

4. Create a summary of your document with Copilot:
- Open an existing document.
- Select Copilot from the ribbon to open the Copilot pane.
- In the Copilot compose box, enter in "summarize this document."
- In Copilot's summary, select References to view citations.

5. Chat with Copilot about your Word document:
- Open the Copilot pane.
- Ask questions about this document or Ask open-ended questions. You can also turn on Microphone to ask your questions.
testScenarios.passFailCriteria:
Description and Expected Result:
- For Draft: Copilot will draft new content for you. Please check the answer is correct and behavior aligned with what your request and working smoothly.
- For Rewrite: Copilot will show you rewritten options to choose from.
- For Table: Copilot will show you what the table will look like.
- For Summary: Review the results of Copilot generated. See if it's aligned.
- For Chat: Check Copilot responded smoothly.

- For Creation: Copilot will draft a presentation for you!
- For Summary: Review result Copilot generated also make sure it works smoothly.
- For Organize: Review result Copilot generated also make sure it works smoothly.
